label: Perle IOLAN SDS8 secure device server
description: 1RU secure serial-to-Ethernet device/terminal server with 8 RJ45 serial ports (software-selectable RS-232/422/485) and one 10/100/1000 Ethernet port; doubles as a console server for 8 console ports.
notes: IOLAN SDS series is 8-port (SDS8) and 16-port (SDS16, superset feature set) in 1RU, each with a single 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet. TrueSerial, SSH/SSL/AES encryption, RADIUS/TACACS+/LDAP/Kerberos auth, Modbus gateway, PPP/SLIP routing. Front, rear or DIN mounting.
